page_title: vfox-lua — A home for every Lua version
description: Manage Lua on Linux, macOS and Windows with vfox or mise. Explore installation, LuaRocks, project version selection and Windows prebuilt packages.
hero_description: Install, switch and pin Lua with vfox or mise. From local development to CI, keep your commands familiar and your environment consistent.
visual_label: Lua, ready for your next run.
feature1_text: Pin the Lua version for your project so terminals, scripts and CI use the same runtime.
feature2_text: LuaRocks is included by default on Linux and macOS. Install modules and load them right away.
feature3_text: Use native vfox capabilities or the vfox plugin backend in mise.
install_title: A few commands. Then you’re in.
install_description: Install the build dependencies, then choose your version manager. These examples use Lua 5.4.7; use the search command to find other releases.
linux_deps: GNU Make, a C compiler and the readline development library. Debian / Ubuntu:
macos_deps: Make, a C compiler (available with Xcode Command Line Tools) and readline:
windows_deps: Source builds need GCC and Make installed through MSYS2 and available on PATH. You can also use the prebuilt option below.
copy_error: Select the command and copy it manually
guide_title: From the first install to your daily run.
guide_project_title: Keep the version with the project
guide_project_text: vfox saves your choice in .vfox.toml and creates a stable .vfox/sdks/lua path. Inside the project, exec can use the selected version directly.
guide_rocks_text: Lua 5.x installs on Linux and macOS include LuaRocks and module search paths by default. If LuaRocks installation fails, the plugin explains why and keeps Lua usable.
guide_windows_text: The default is a source build using MSYS2. This installation option downloads LuaBinaries instead; versions that are not provided fail with a clear message.
windows_integrity: Prebuilt archives use SourceForge HTTPS mirrors without a pinned SHA-256 check. Use the default source build if you need download integrity verification.
faq1_question: How do I find other Lua versions?
faq1_answer: Run vfox search lua or mise ls-remote vfox:yeshan333/vfox-lua. Replace 5.4.7 in the examples with the version you need.
faq2_answer: Yes. Set VFOX_LUA_LUAROCKS=0 or false before installation. LuaRocks is currently not included on Windows.
faq3_question: Which platforms and older releases are supported?
faq3_answer: Linux, macOS and Windows are supported. Lua 5.0 and earlier are not supported on Linux; prebuilt Windows packages support only the versions listed above.
faq4_question: How do I update the plugin?
faq4_answer: Run vfox update lua. Plugins added with the installation command on this site read updates from the manifest published in this repository.
closing_text: Find the source, report an issue or explore the releases on GitHub.
